_about: Live experiment plan (Parth). Run with tools/experiments/run_plan.py <ID>. Each experiment changes ONE thing against the baseline of all 74 practice games so far (datasets/runs/, 2026-10-10 ~17:30). Evidence and reasoning: analysis/strategy_0.95.md.

E1.title: RFQ: every bidder answered within its 60 s (parallel sends)
E1.change: commit d85babc: play() sends to all bidders in parallel; the agent answers the bidders whose reply is in
E1.hypothesis: No timeouts; rival offers cited every round to every bidder ('much lower rival quote -> give the step'); P05 well above 0.39.
E1.evidence: Live P05 f8604d43d3fbf92f: 6 timeouts, a bidder at EUR 38.50 went to 31.00 then agreed 30.25 after ONE rival citation; offline test fails on the old loop (3 timeouts, thread lost) and passes on the new one.
E1.keep_if: 0 timeouts in both games AND mean score >= 0.65 (P05 best so far 0.588)

E2.title: Round-1 argument backbone in code
E2.change: commit 392174a: round 1 = top 3 arguments by evidence order (price history > should-cost > forecast > quality > falling index), one forecast per case; later rounds always the next unused one
E2.hypothesis: The first counter rises where the model used to drop the decisive argument (P10 should-cost, P18 3 of 4 dropped); finals follow (final ~ first counter + steps).
E2.evidence: First counters with vs without the right data: P01 0.66 vs 0.34, P18 0.49 vs 0.27, P02 0.36 vs 0.14, P10 0.66 vs 0.55 (should-cost at lead 42).
E2.keep_if: first counter >= baseline best_first_counter - 0.02 in >= 3 of 4 AND no final below its case median - 0.05

E3.title: Other parts' price jumps as round-2+ arguments
E3.hypothesis: api.md: 'Order lines of different parts are separate arguments'. P18's supplier raised all 3 bars +11% in July; the 2 other bars' histories in rounds 2-3 are verified and taken into account -> bigger steps.
E3.evidence: Price history was P18's strongest argument (+0.2 on the first counter). Risk: 'irrelevant' or 'duplicate' (no trust cost); 'contradicted' would cost trust (IDs are pre-checked by the builder).
E3.keep_if: no 'contradicted' AND the other-part claims come back verified AND mean final >= 0.59 (P18 median 0.539 + 0.05)

E4.title: Full pass with the build that won E1-E3 (gate before merging to main)
E4.change: everything kept; pass the kept switches with --switches
E4.hypothesis: No case regresses; RFQ and argument fixes lift the mean.
E4.keep_if: mean score >= 0.68 AND no case below its median - 0.10

HOLD.title: Round-1 hold: our first e-mail after one timeout round (A arm)
HOLD.change: switch hold_r1 (play.py waits 65 s before the first e-mail to a single supplier)
HOLD.hypothesis: A timeout drops the supplier's patience: it concedes faster and ends lower (P05 scripted: first counter 28.00/27.50 vs 30.00-30.50, record 0.965; P11 held path 44.45 vs 44.50).
HOLD.keep_if: mean score of HOLD > mean of HOLD0 by >= 0.03 AND no case worse by > 0.05

HOLD0.title: Round-1 hold: control arm (same agent build and cases, no hold)
